## Contributor Checklist

Please confirm that you have followed the rules in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) by checking these boxes:

### Path & Scope Rules
- [ ] I have **only** edited files inside the `/next/` folder.
- [ ] I have **not** modified any frozen `/vX.Y/` versioned folders.

### Code Examples Rule (Critical)
- [ ] I have **NOT** added any TypeScript or Go code examples (full snippets) to the shared docs.
- [ ] If I needed to reference a code example, I used a **link** to the relevant file in `redis-smq` or `go-redis-smq` repositories instead.
- [ ] I have verified that the links I added point to existing files.

### Implementation Readiness (The "Blocking" Rule)
- [ ] The feature/change described in this PR is **already merged** into `redis-smq/next`.
- [ ] The feature/change described in this PR is **already merged** into `go-redis-smq/next`.

*(If either implementation is not ready, keep this PR in **Draft** mode until both are merged.)*

### Content Quality
- [ ] I have updated the relevant configuration schemas, behavior descriptions, or diagrams to match the new feature.
- [ ] I have tested that any Mermaid/ASCII diagrams render correctly (if applicable).
